title: Keyboard focus recovers when a work order leaves the filter
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. The final keyboard-interaction design (SQ-15/UX-19).
  5. AUTOMATION note: design-pending; verify once finalized.
custom_steps:
1. With keyboard focus on a work order, cause it to leave the filter results; confirm focus recovers to the defined place.
  2. With keyboard focus in a technician's area, deactivate that technician; confirm focus recovers to the defined place.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Keyboard focus recovers sensibly when a work order leaves the filter results (per final design).
  • Keyboard focus recovers sensibly when a technician becomes inactive (per final design).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10054 — Story 11 Keyboard access and focus. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S11-E1, S11-E2 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-E1: “Design must define focus recovery when a work order leaves the filter result.”
  • S11-E2: “Design must define focus recovery when a technician becomes inactive.”
